production.note: One US model year. BMW: "the new 2023 BMW M4 CSL", "Global production limited to 1,000 units", production beginning in July 2022 at Plant Dingolfing. RM Sotheby's calls it a "single-production-year halo car", "291 of which were allocated to North America" (rmsothebys-2023-m4-csl).

configuration.note: Release table: "Config. / no. cylinders / valves Inline / 6 / 24"

fuel.note: Gasoline inline-six; inferred from the release's description.

transmission.note: "8-speed M Steptronic transmission with Drivelogic" (a torque-converter automatic); the only transmission.

powerHp.note: Quote (release table): "Max output (hp @ rpm) 543 @ 6,250"; text: "maximum output of 543 hp at 6,250 rpm". Both readings agree.

weightLb.note: US curb weight, the only configuration (coupe, 8-speed automatic). Quote (release table): "Curb weight (lbs) 3,640". Confirmed in both the release page and its attachment (bmw-us-2023-m4-csl-attachment).
